note: Full Y3S2 mastery tree catalog. Names and effects mirror in-game text via the community language file. Entries Luke verified from his own in-game tooltips or Ubisoft patch notes are marked confirmed in seasonal_buffs.json and take precedence over this catalog where they differ.

nodes.name: Impetus Order
nodes.effect: You can now gain stacks of Impetus. When at 5 stacks of Impetus, consume 5 stacks to increase Turn Speed, Acceleration and Top Speed by 5% for 30s. When another Order Perk is activated, this buff no longer consumes Impetus and is applied permanently.

nodes.name: Battering Force
nodes.effect: Generate 5 stacks of Impetus (Max 10) upon Ramming or performing a Crew Attack. Generating Impetus increases Weapon Damage and Repair Amount by 50% for 10s.

nodes.name: Relentless Force
nodes.effect: Generate 1 stack of Impetus (Max 10) for every 8 weapon hits on enemies. Demicannons require 4 times as many hits. Generating Impetus increases Weapon Damage and Repair Amount by 15% for 5s.

nodes.name: Unstoppable Force
nodes.effect: Generate 1 stack of Impetus (Max 10) for every 110m travelled. Generating Impetus increases Weapon Damage and Repair Amount by 3% for every knot of speed above 10 knots, for 5s.

nodes.name: Heavy Bombardment
nodes.effect: Generating Impetus increases the radius of all weapon Area-of-Effects by 5m for 10s (Max 5 stacks). At max stacks, Secondary Damage for all weapons is increased by 20%.

nodes.name: Rejuvenation
nodes.effect: Generating Impetus restores 3% of max HP.

nodes.name: Weakness Finder
nodes.effect: Generating Impetus adds a 20% chance to convert any weapon shot into a weakpoint hit for 5s.

nodes.name: Firepower Order
nodes.effect: When at 10 stacks of Impetus, fire an Auxiliary weapon to consume 10 stacks and convert all weapon hits to weakpoint hits for 8s.

nodes.name: Mending Order
nodes.effect: When at 5 stacks of Impetus, brace for 2s and release to consume 5 stacks and release an AoE heal that heals you for 30% of your max. Hull Health as well as all allies within 350m. This effect also triggers automatically when below 50% max. Hull Health or on death.

nodes.name: Stormblaze Order
nodes.effect: When at 10 stacks of Impetus, the next weapon hit consumes 10 stacks and triggers an AoE burst on the target that deals 150% of your max. Hull Health as Burning & Lightning damage to all enemies within 250m. This effect can also be triggered by Ramming without it consuming Impetus.

nodes.name: Adaptive Arsenal
nodes.effect: Increases Weapon Damage by 5% for each different weapon type equipped

nodes.name: Adrenal Surge
nodes.effect: Restores 10% Hull Health after a Crew Attack.

nodes.name: Battle Tempo
nodes.effect: Increases the maximum stacks of Impetus by 5.

nodes.name: Care And Carnage
nodes.effect: For every 10% increases of Repair per Shot, increase Weapon Damage by 5% up to a maximum of 30%.

nodes.name: Critical Damage Control
nodes.effect: Repairs 4% of Severe Damage per second after not taking damage for 30s.

nodes.name: Enduring Brace
nodes.effect: Increase Brace Strength Recovery by 0.01% per 1000 points of Maximum Health.

nodes.name: Fire And Steel
nodes.effect: Generate 1 stack of Impetus by applying any elemental status effect on a target. This effect can only trigger once every 5s.

nodes.name: Fortified Hull
nodes.effect: For every 2000 points of Brace Strength, increase incoming Repair Amount by 1% (max 10%).

nodes.name: Hullbreaker
nodes.effect: Increase Ramming Damage by 50% when sailing at 15kts or higher.

nodes.name: Hardened Momentum
nodes.effect: While at or above 5 stacks of Impetus, increase Armor Multiplier by 5%.

nodes.name: Killing Drive
nodes.effect: Generate 1 stack of Impetus by destroying a target. This effect can only trigger once every 5s.

nodes.name: Loaded Odds
nodes.effect: Adds a chance of 10% to generate an additional stack of Impetus whenever an Impetus stack is generated.

nodes.name: Revitalized Fury
nodes.effect: Increases Weapon Damage and Repair Amount by 15% for 5s when receiving a heal of 3% of your Maximum Health or greater.

nodes.name: Slow Mending
nodes.effect: Repairs 0.6% of Hull Health per second after not taking damage for 30s.

nodes.name: True Grit
nodes.effect: Reduce damage taken by 10% when Hull Health is 30% or below.

nodes.name: Volatile Arsenal
nodes.effect: Increases elemental damage by 5% for each Weapon element equipped. Includes Elements gained from Weapon modifications

nodes.name: Vital Strike
nodes.effect: Generate 1 stack of Impetus by destroying a weakpoint. This effect can only trigger once every 5s.

nodes.name: Wind Barrier
nodes.effect: Reduces damage taken by 10% while sailing at 15kts or above.
